h1: Custom Pre Roll Tubes for Branded Promotions
metaTitle: Custom Pre Roll Tubes | Perfect Imprints
metaDescription: Order custom pre roll tubes with your logo. Perfect for dispensaries, events & gifts. Bulk pricing available. Fast turnaround.
introHtml:
Marketing directors in the cannabis industry need packaging that protects products and reinforces brand identity. Custom pre roll tubes are ideal for dispensary giveaways, product launches, and promotional events. HR directors can include them in employee wellness kits or as part of a branded merchandise program. Business owners looking to stand out at trade shows or in retail settings will find these tubes a practical and memorable option.

Our selection of custom pre roll tubes offers various materials, sizes, and closure styles to suit your needs. From classic plastic tubes with child-resistant caps to eco-friendly cardboard options, you can personalize each tube with your logo, artwork, or messaging. Whether you need a small batch for a local event or a large order for ongoing distribution, we have the inventory and decoration capabilities to deliver quality results.
buyingGuideHtml:
When ordering custom pre roll tubes, start by considering the material. Plastic tubes offer durability and moisture protection, while cardboard tubes are biodegradable and give a natural feel. Both can be decorated with your logo using screen printing, foil stamping, or full-color labels. For a premium look, consider metallic finishes or custom colors that match your brand.

Key Features to Look For

Pay attention to the tube dimensions to ensure a snug fit for your pre rolls. Child-resistant closures are important for safety compliance, especially in regulated markets. Some tubes come with integrated humidity packs to maintain freshness. If you plan to include multiple pre rolls, look for multi-pack tube designs or tubes with dividers.

Common use cases include dispensary giveaways, promotional packs at cannabis events, and branded merchandise for loyalty programs. Marketing directors often use custom pre roll tubes as part of a larger swag bag at industry conferences. HR directors may include them in employee appreciation kits or as part of a wellness program. Business owners can sell them as retail packaging or use them for product sampling.

Decoration options vary by material. Plastic tubes accept screen printing and pad printing for simple logos, while full-color heat transfer labels work well for complex artwork. Cardboard tubes can be printed directly with offset or digital printing. Embossing or debossing adds a tactile element. For small quantities, consider using adhesive labels instead of direct printing to save on setup costs.

Minimum order quantities (MOQs) typically start at 100 to 500 units for custom printing, depending on the complexity. As order volume increases, the per-unit cost drops significantly. If you need a low quantity for a test run, consider stock tubes with a label applied. For large events or ongoing needs, ordering in bulk (1,000+) offers the best value. Lead times range from 2 to 4 weeks for custom orders, with rush options available.

Avoid common mistakes like ordering tubes that are too short or too wide for your pre rolls. Always request a sample before placing a bulk order to verify fit and print quality. Check that the closure mechanism is secure and easy to open. If you need child-resistant features, confirm that the tube meets relevant safety standards. Finally, consider the environmental impact: recyclable or compostable materials can be a selling point for eco-conscious consumers.
buyingGuideH2: Custom Pre Roll Tubes Buying Guide

faqs.q: What are the most common materials for custom pre roll tubes?
faqs.a: The most common materials are plastic (polypropylene or polyethylene) and cardboard. Plastic tubes are durable and moisture-resistant, while cardboard tubes are eco-friendly and biodegradable. Both can be customized with printing or labels.

faqs.q: What is the typical minimum order quantity for printed tubes?
faqs.a: Minimum order quantities typically start at 100 to 500 units for custom printing, depending on the decoration method and complexity. For smaller quantities, you can use stock tubes with adhesive labels.

faqs.q: Can I get child-resistant closures on my pre roll tubes?
faqs.a: Yes, many of our pre roll tubes offer child-resistant caps that meet safety standards. Be sure to specify this requirement when ordering, as it may affect pricing and lead time.

faqs.q: How long does it take to receive custom pre roll tubes?
faqs.a: Standard production lead time is 2 to 4 weeks from artwork approval. Rush orders may be available for an additional fee. Shipping time depends on your location and chosen carrier.

faqs.q: Can I get a sample before placing a bulk order?
faqs.a: Yes, we recommend ordering a sample of the blank tube or a printed proof to verify size, fit, and print quality. Samples are typically available for a nominal fee.
